outcome: rates of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
rates of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: 4,135,247 nonanomalous singleton, cephalic deliveries between 37 and 42 weeks of gestation, with a history of previous cesarean delivery and delivered in a hospital between 2010 and 2019
finding: While both TOLAC and VBAC rates increased from 2010 to 2019, over 80% of patients with a history of previous cesarean delivery still deliver by repeat scheduled cesarean delivery.
